title: Baitul Mukarram National Mosque
visualBrief: Individual medium-fi Baitul Mukarram National Mosque: cubic western prayer hall with three dark bands and triple-pointed-arch entrance, open paved east court, low pointed galleries, tall east through gate and southeastern octagonal minaret with flared lantern and small pale cap. Raw compound retained; internal partitions and all heights are picture estimates. Six existing shared 256² graphs and seven merged roles; four budgeted browser LODs. Fine art, furnished interiors and surrounding city omitted.

sourceFacts.horizontalBasis: Retained exact way 186664126 / Q804009 is current viewer building 35184558752958. Its eight-vertex T-shaped outline, original anchor [90.412617,23.7294861] and heading zero remain fixed. Positive X east points from the western cubic prayer hall toward the open forecourt and east gate; positive Z is south. Pictures guide that signed layout. Current PMTiles have no height tags, courtyard holes or independent roof/minaret parts. The court, cubic hall partitions, gate and southeastern tower position are explicit picture-led approximations within the mapped compound. Adjacent shops, streets and city buildings remain host content.
sourceFacts.architecturalHeights: No retained or current map heights exist. Visualization estimates: cubic hall roof/parapet 33.5 m; three dark bands at 27.6, 29.3 and 31 m; projecting triple-arch screen 22 m. Low courtyard galleries about 9 m, east gate 19.5 m. Minaret has an octagonal shaft, flared crown around 49 m, lantern to 53.2 m, pale cap to 56.2 m and finial top 57.4 m. Facade bays, gate widths, minor parapets and all vertical dimensions are estimates, not survey data. Fine calligraphy, lattice art, fixtures and unseen interiors are omitted.
